person_note: Sebastian Rudd is the participating base narrator. Numerous interior Goodreads passages independently show him narrating his legal work, relationships, reactions, and past actions as “I” or “we”; the authorized opening establishes the same voice, while whole-book secondary sources identify Rudd as the novel’s narrator and explicitly as its first-person narrator. Third-person-only passages describe people Sebastian observes and therefore remain unmarked rather than indicating a third-person strand. Generic societal “we/our,” advertising-style “you,” dialogue, and aphorisms were not promoted to base-person evidence. No sustained alternate narrator, frame, diary, or epistolary structure was found. The authorized excerpt is limited to the opening, but the broad interior quote coverage and whole-book descriptions remove the main scope uncertainty.
